query: I just got back from walking my dog this afternoon, he was so excited to chase a squirrel around the park that he pulled the leash right out of my hand and I had to run after him for five whole minutes. On the way home I stopped at the little bakery on the corner and picked up a matcha croissant that was still warm, it was so flaky and sweet, I almost finished the whole thing before I even walked through my front door. Oh, also my houseplant that I've been nursing for three months finally grew a new leaf yesterday, I was so happy I took like ten photos of it to send to my friend. Anyway, I need to exchange a delivered item from my order #W2890441: I want to change the item 8069050545 to item 1071497737, and use credit_card_1061405 as the payment method for any applicable fees for this exchange.
